name: skills
description: Capture, refine and execute GitHub issues, maintain specifications and documentation, coordinate reviewed task workflows, and optimize skill tokens.

interface.shortDescription: Issue refinement, specs, docs, tasks, and optimization
defaultPrompt: Use specbook to write or review capability specifications in spec/.
Use docbook to write or organize documentation in docs/.
Use skill-optimize to reduce skill tokens while preserving instructions and report comparable before/after counts.
Use issue-create to capture a request in the selected backlog using its repository conventions.
Use issue-refine to clarify an issue, split coherent deliveries when needed, and return Ready issue URLs.
Use task-orchestrate to coordinate an isolated repository task through specification planning, implementation, documentation, and all three review gates to a pull request.
Use issue-execute for explicitly scoped issue or comment requests and return evidence for review.
